name: How much does a delivery truck accident attorney cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a delivery truck accident attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most delivery truck accident attorneys work on a contingency fee basis. This means you typically do not pay any upfront fees or hourly rates. Instead, the attorney's fee is a percentage of the final settlement or court award you receive. If your case does not result in a recovery, you generally do not owe attorney's fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without financial burden. Be sure to discuss the specific contingency fee percentage and any potential costs upfront during your initial consultation.
